content.short: JokeRace is an on-chain contest platform used by top DAOs for hackathons, grants, and reputation building.
content.description:
JokeRace is a premier on-chain contest and governance protocol designed to empower decentralized communities through structured competition and reputation building. Used by prominent projects like Polygon and Farcaster, the platform allows DAOs to run hackathons, grant programs, and governance experiments in a transparent and verifiable manner. Unlike traditional token-weighted systems, JokeRace emphasizes on-chain reputation, where users earn attestations for their contributions and influence within a community.

The protocol features unique mechanics like "Vote and Earn," where participants are rewarded for accurately predicting or persuading others toward winning entries. This incentivizes active and thoughtful participation, fostering a more engaged and meritocratic governance environment. By providing the essential infrastructure for community-driven decision-making, JokeRace is helping to redefine how decentralized organizations coordinate, reward, and recognize their most valuable members.
content.meta: JokeRace provides on-chain contest tools and reputation-based governance for decentralized communities and DAOs.
